answer: The relic schedule is applied in glacier and sparrow reveals each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1541 identities would post 1131 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
